introHtml: Custom stress reliever keychains combine the utility of a keychain with a functional stress toy, making them ideal for trade shows, employee wellness kits, and safety incentives. Choose from soft foam shapes or silicone designs that can be debossed or screen-printed with your logo. These compact giveaways provide a tactile reminder of your brand during stressful moments, ensuring repeated impressions throughout the day.
